fields.title: 📖 Calling upon Allah in Grief
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said in distress:

> ***“Yā Ḥayyu, Yā Qayyūm, through Your mercy I seek help.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The believer directs his heart in grief to **Allah**, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer. True help begins with ***Istighāthah with Allah***.

immutable.source: 📝 at-Tirmidhī, al-Jāmiʿ, Kitāb ad-Daʿawāt, Hadith Nr. 3524; überliefert von Anas ibn Mālik.
